verbatim_quote.original: serach how agents like opencode works and keep sessions ? we need use same techniqe, we can use simple json but make sure it keep all history for each task
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Research how agents like opencode keep sessions. We need the same technique. Simple JSON is fine, but make sure it keeps all history for each task.

extracted_decision.summary: Store the full per-task history durably and bound only the view sent to the model; simple JSON storage is acceptable.
extracted_decision.rationale: Long sessions must never lose history; the industry pattern is to persist everything and compact only what is sent.
alternatives: Cap stored history to bound storage
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Unbounded storage growth in exchange for never discarding a turn.
